kind: Post-finding repair-comparator protocol; source-informed, not held-out
finding: Interrupted rotate loses unrelated survivor readability after database commit and before fresh state publication. No forgotten plaintext recovered.

prior_disclosure_check.scope: First public issues page and bounded exact-name web searches. Not proof of novelty or absence of private/deleted disclosures. No upstream contact.

proposed_comparator: Generation-tagged key journal outside the ciphertext database
sequence: Serialize writes and recover any pending transition before accepting new operations.
Stage a fresh key-state generation in a separate durable journal without moving keys into the ciphertext database. Retain the already-punctured old state during transition.
Commit all re-encrypted survivor rows and a non-secret generation marker in one SQLite transaction.
Publish the selected fresh state; clear transition journal after recovery-safe publication.
On reopen, select old/new key state using the committed database generation marker; fail closed for missing/inconsistent metadata.
mandatory_controls: Exit before database commit recovers old generation.
Exit after database commit before key-state publication recovers fresh generation.
Exit after state publication before journal cleanup recovers fresh generation.
Forgotten source and derivative never become readable in any tested recovery.
No plaintext keys added to ciphertext database; no concurrent writer or malicious journal rollback guarantee claimed.
limits: Known write-ahead journaling and generation binding, not a new cryptographic construction.
Process interruption only; filesystem power-loss durability and external backup of key journals unvalidated.
Retaining intermediate key material requires explicit operational handling; cannot claim secure deletion of arbitrary journal copies.
Prototype would cover core store compaction, not vector index or mem0.
next_action: Implement an isolated comparator against pinned code and run the declared phase-boundary controls. Preserve original experiment and upstream bytes.
